notes.title: Notes for Steam Version of Disgaea 5 Complete
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32530184/1d6f64dc1c6fe7986b7d729a4ee9754980968920.jpg[/img]
With [i]Disgaea 5 Complete[/i] now available on Steam, we wanted to take an opportunity to clarify some of the key differences between [i]Disgaea 5 Complete[/i] on Steam versus other platforms. We hope this small update clears up any confusion you may experience as you jump into the world of [i]Disgaea 5 Complete[/i].

The following network items are not available on the Steam version of [i]Disgaea 5 Complete[/i]:

[u]Data Shop[/u]
Everybody’s NW, Someone’s Records

[u]Netherworld Edit Shop[/u]
Netherworld Network, User Netherworld

[u]Map Edit Shop[/u]
Facility Removed

[u]Settings[/u]
User Netherworld, User News

[u]Strategy Assembly[/u]
Spread News to Everyone!, Give Item to a Friend!

[u]Netherworld Hub[/u]
Map Edit Shop NPC

Due to irreconcilable platform differences, it was decided in the beginning of development for [i]Disgaea 5 Complete[/i] that the Network functions from the original game could not be implemented into the Steam version. We deeply apologize that these differences were not communicated in advance, and we appreciate your patience and understanding in this matter. We would like to remind all users that Steam purchases come with a option to fully refund the purchase if total playtime has not exceeded 2 hours.

For more information, or if you would like to report any further issue you may find, please join us in the forums here: 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/803600/discussions/4/1732090362058875091/

We are humbled and grateful for the overwhelming passion and excitement that you, the fans, have shown us in the weeks leading up to the release of [i]Disgaea 5 Complete[/i] on PC. Thank you for your support, doods.

notes.title: Update to Disgaea 5 Complete Pricing and Release Window
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First of all, we'd like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience that the delay of Disgaea 5 Complete for PC has caused everyone. Today, we have an update for those who have been waiting. We are lowering our price for the title from the original $49.99 (discounted for pre-purchasers [b]to $39.99[/b]), now to $39.99 (now available to pre-purchasers for [b]$29.99[/b]). The Digital Dood edition of the game, which includes the standard game and art book, will be available for $42.73 (available for pre-purchase for $32.75).

Those who pre-purchased the game back in May will be automatically upgraded to receive the art book from the Digital Dood Edition, free of charge, by purchasing the [b]standard version of the game[/b]. Those that did not pre-purchase the title in May will need to purchase the Digital Dood Edition to receive the art book included with purchase.

For those that have already pre-purchased, we thank you for your patience and appreciation. To make sure that no overcharging will occur and ensure the best price for all users, we have requested Valve to refund all purchases of the game to this date. Should you want to repurchase the title, you can now do so on this page and receive the newly lowered price.

This special pricing will continue one week after release of the game. Disgaea 5 Complete will arrive on Steam in October, with a new closed beta test arriving in September. Make sure to follow us on Twitter (@NISAmerica) for immediate updates and notifications regarding the beta.

Thank you for your patience, and we hope you look forward to the game's launch in October.

Sincerely,
NIS America, Inc.
